def brief(self):
    return "<" + self.title + ">"

Course.summary = brief
print(OnlineCourse("파이썬", 40, "rokey.kr").summary())
print(Course("수학", 20).summary())

def new_init(self, title, hours):
    self.title = "[" + title + "]"
    self.hours = hours * 2

Course.__init__ = new_init
